title: Split ribbon
idea: The same ribbon hanging from the top edge, split down the middle by one straight slot that runs from the edge into the notch. The slot is the only negative space: it turns one bookmark into two ribbons, like a book with two markers, and two bars side by side read as pause.
built: Ribbon 40 dp wide from y 0 (past the top of every mask) to tips at y 79, Shelf's notch (12.9 dp), tips r 1.76; the rounded tips reach 30.2 dp from the centre. The slot is 8 dp, a fifth of the width, leaving two 16 dp bars: wide enough to read as a deliberate cut and as pause, narrow enough that the outline stays one bookmark. The notch is shared, so each bar's foot slopes from its outer tip up to the slot, meeting it at y 68.6; those inner corners stay sharp, like the notch's apex. Nothing else is cut.
small: Nothing needs dropping. The cuts keep a lip of tile above the bars, 3 px at 48, 2 at 32 and 1 at 16, the smallest detail each size allows: bled to the edge, the paper bars merged with light browser toolbars, and the tile's sides with the dark slot between them read as a bold W. 48: ribbon 28 px, slot 6 px, bars 11 px, notch 9 px over 14. 32: ribbon 18 px, slot 4 px, bars 7 px, notch 6 px. 16: ribbon 8 px, slot 2 px, bars 3 px, notch 4 px at 45 degrees, so each foot is a clean three-step stair. The cuts' slots are about 9 dp, a touch wider than the master's 8, because a slot has to be an even number of pixels to stay centred. Glyph: the whole bookmark, 16 px wide with its outer round shoulders, split by a 4 px slot into two 6 px bars.
risks: Two bars are the most familiar media sign there is, so at a glance it can say pause before it says bookmark; the shared notch and the bleed keep it Shelf's. Pause says stopped for now: that suits a place kept for later, but it says listen less directly than a play. On a near-white wallpaper the paper bars merge with the background and the dark frame with the slot can read as a W or a Cyrillic Ш, the same failure the toolbar cuts' lip fixes; the launcher has no such fix without giving up the bleed. On wallpapers near graphite the bar tops look flat or arched. The launch screens need an edge to hang the ribbons from.
